title: Eco-friendly and recyclable ionic liquid–zinc chloride catalyst supported on graphene oxide from Nypa fruticans husk for green synthesis of 2-amino-3-cyanopyridine derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28853-28869
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04734J, Paper
Open Access

Y.-Nhi Thi Nguyen, Dat Minh Tran, Thai The Nguyen, Hai Truong Nguyen
This study successfully demonstrates the application of GO/IL/ZnxCly as a novel and environmentally friendly catalyst for the synthesis of 2-amino-3-cyanopyridine derivatives.
